title: EmailSubmissionFilterCondition has no serialization tests
description: crate-jmap-mail-types/src/submission.rs defines EmailSubmissionFilterCondition (lines 281-317) but has zero test coverage. Every other filter type (EmailFilterCondition, EmailComparator) has roundtrip and serialization tests. Missing: at minimum a roundtrip test for the empty case, one for each field, and a Filter<EmailSubmissionFilterCondition> operator test. Without tests, a camelCase rename regression (e.g. undoStatus vs undo_status) would go undetected.
